name: medqa_s12_v1_r2_strict_early
responses: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

My main symptom is Severe right groin pain. I also have Pain in both knees, Right leg is slightly shortened, flexed, adducted, and internally rotated. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Acute appendicitis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.
Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Works as an elementary school teacher. Non-smoker and drinks alcohol socially.
Alert and active. No head injury, abdominal pain, or chest pain reported.
